name: Karlun's Fort
title: Karlun's Fort
summary: Karlun's Fort sits on a 100 m rock pinnacle just outside Silyun, at 89.0N 67.6W. Four 26 m gold-spired towers and 12 m walls surround a red-roofed house, a blue-flamed golden lamp, black columns and the Hall of Karlun and exit portals. The rock falls 35 m north to Sir Ginazio and Iian di Alduressa's camp, with columns, an anvil and hammer, a barrel, the Breastplate of Karlun and Karlun's Fort portal at z 66. To the east it falls 100 m to a river.

shots.standingOrder: From the east edge of Karlun's Fort fly level east, crest the rock and dive 110 m down past the cliff to the river, pulling out 3 m over the river with the golden sun behind; keep 15 m off the face.
shots.notes: FPV dive at golden hour. The craft starts at the fort's east edge beside the red-roofed house, flies level east, crests the rock's edge and dives -82 deg, 110 m down past the cliff, then pulls out 3 m above the riverbank and runs out over the river with the golden sun behind. The cliff face stays at least 16 m from the lens horizontally (measured every 0.5 s). The window (t 2-7.5) covers the crest and the dive; the cliff foot leaves the frame in the pull-out. shots.standingOrder: Jib up from Sir Ginazio's camp at the foot of the rock, past the 35 m cliff, until Karlun's Fort and its gold spires stand against the golden western sky; keep 5 m from the camp's columns and gear.
